The '''Lig''' were a tribe of [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] well known for their fine swordsmiths. The [[Lig sword]] was named for them.<ref name="Lord of War">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/86/indexp2.html|text=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War|int=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War}}</ref>
